candidates.change_summary: Delete the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll so anyone can call it.
Replace withdraw(address(this).balance) with a no-op so withdrawAll does nothing.
Replace withdraw(address(this).balance) with selfdestruct to owner so balance changes differently.
Delete the require statement in onlyOwner so modifier never reverts.
Replace msg.sender == owner with true so onlyOwner always passes.
Delete the require statement in the onlyOwner modifier so access control is removed.
Replace transfer of _value to msg.sender with transfer of 0 so owner receives nothing.
Remove onlyOwner modifier from withdraw(uint) to allow anyone to call it.
Remove the revert on failure in sendMoney so the function always succeeds without reverting on a failed call.
Delete the entire low-level call in sendMoney, so no external call or ETH transfer occurs, changing the target's balance.
Delete the onlyOwner modifier body check, making sendMoney callable by anyone, which can change the behavior when a non-owner calls it.
Change the call to use a regular transfer instead of a low-level call, removing the ability to pass arbitrary data and potentially changing success/failure conditions.
